parse_to_dataset_malformed_02.spec: RDF 1.1 TriG, section 6 (Parsing): a parse is defined for a TriG document only; text with a syntax error is not one, so no partial result is specified
parse_to_dataset_malformed_02.note: Jena streams quads into the target and keeps the quad read before the syntax error (the test expects 1). leana reads the whole document with @factoidal/core parse(), which is all-or-nothing, so the target is unchanged (0).
